notes: Theoretical minimums are first-order estimates from confinement (lambda/2n), quarter-wave thickness (lambda/4n), phase-shift length, bend/resonator scale, and P1 thermal crosstalk spacing.
Effective dimensions multiply geometric minimums by a failure handicap (yield guardband, alignment, redundancy/spares, crosstalk guards, ECC/logical overhead).

Material light behavior: Sb2S3 large dn (0.6) enables compact phase/NV states but requires 300C isolation; VO2 low-threshold volatile switching; azo/spiro small dn for trim; dielectrics (SiN/SiO2/TiO2) low-loss NIR for membranes; EO shifts n rapidly for fast tuning.
Not fabrication-ready; requires FDTD/FEM, thermal 3D, process-specific DRC, and experimental calibration.

proposals.name: Interferometric PCM (Ref)
proposals.limiting_factors: Thermal crosstalk (300C Sb2S3 vs 68C VO2), MZI arm length for 2pi, waveguide coupling
proposals.material_light_behavior: Sb2S3 dn=0.6 (amorph/cryst) gives phase shift but needs thermal isolation; VO2 fast volatile switch low threshold; azo/spiro small dn for trim/config; SiN low loss NIR
proposals.assumptions: lambda_s=1550nm, Gamma=0.35, P1 thermal pitch>=10um (safe), axial sep 8um, passive margins for splitters

proposals.name: Resonant WDM bank (microrings)
proposals.limiting_factors: Bend loss/radius, resonator-to-bus coupling gap, thermal sensitivity of resonance
proposals.material_light_behavior: High-Q resonance concentrates field (strong lambda selectivity) but narrow linewidth increases sensitivity to dn, temperature and fabrication; WDM multiplies capacity per bus
proposals.assumptions: R_min~8um (conservative SiPh), coupling gaps ~200-300nm feasible but guarded, vertical stack modest

proposals.name: Thin-film membrane stack (passive WDM)
proposals.limiting_factors: Layer thickness tolerance (nm-scale), interface loss/roughness, lateral coupling/alignment
proposals.material_light_behavior: Interference constructive/destructive set by n*d: quarter-wave layers give strong spectral selectivity; SiN/SiO2/TiO2 low loss in NIR, no thermal switching crosstalk
proposals.assumptions: ~16 alternating layers, t_qw(SiN)~194nm t_qw(SiO2)~267nm, lateral pixel >=2um

proposals.name: Thin-film membrane/F-P stack (EO-tuned)
proposals.limiting_factors: EO overlap and electrode spacing, nm thickness control, thermal drift of resonance, optical loss
proposals.material_light_behavior: EO (Pockels) shifts n -> shifts resonance/phase condition fast without moving mass; dielectric stack provides high density WDM; heating from drivers managed by spacing
proposals.assumptions: Adds EO layer and field margins over G1; fast reconfig but more interfaces

proposals.name: Thin-film membrane stack (PCM+EO hybrid)
proposals.limiting_factors: PCM crystallization volume/thermal isolation, EO electrode spacing, multilayer tolerance
proposals.material_light_behavior: Sb2S3 provides large dn NV state (n*d step) for persistent spectral weight; EO gives fast fine trim; thermal 300C write requires local confinement/guarding even in thin layers
proposals.assumptions: Hybrid NV+fast; PCM thermal guard increases effective spacing vs G1/G2

proposals.name: Open WDM-PCM (A1+G1+B3)
proposals.limiting_factors: PCM thermal isolation, ring bend/coupling, multilayer alignment, cumulative loss budget
proposals.material_light_behavior: Combines A1 large dn NV weights, G1 passive n*d spectral selectivity (no tuning loss), B3 resonant WDM; mostly standard dielectrics + established PIC elements
proposals.assumptions: Modular tile; lateral set by thermal-safe PCM pitch and ring routing; vertical by passive stack + PIC layers

proposals.name: Membrane-Brush NV (A1+G3+3D)
proposals.limiting_factors: 3D alignment, vertical thermal isolation between 300C segments, interlayer coupling, yield compounding in 3D
proposals.material_light_behavior: 3D stacking multiplies capacity/volume: PCM NV states per voxel + membrane n*d spectral channels; light guided/reflected (45°) along bristle; thermal isolation critical axially/laterally
proposals.assumptions: Footprint per bristle set by thermal pitch; height by voxel count*segment separation; 3D yield/alignment handicap applied

proposals.name: Volumetric Tensor Membrane (G2/G3+F2+A1)
proposals.limiting_factors: Diffractive alignment and phase uniformity, multi-layer registration, compounded 3D yield, thermal management
proposals.material_light_behavior: EO-tuned and PCM-assisted n*d membranes for local tensor ops + diffractive/global interference mixing; highest functional density but tight phase/alignment tolerances
proposals.assumptions: Aggressive stacking and diffractive sections; highest handicap due to compounded tolerances/yield in complex 3D
